question:
Select the most appropriate option to improve the bold part of the sentence.

The teacher **explained him the topic.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"explained"** means to make an idea, situation, or problem clear to someone by describing it in detail or revealing relevant facts. (समझाना)

 
 
• **Example: **The professor explained the complex theory in simple terms for the students.
 
 
 
• The correct phrase is **"explained the topic to him"**, which is grammatically accurate and conveys the intended meaning. (उसने उसे विषय समझाया)
 
 
• **Example: **The teacher explained the topic to him so he could understand it better.
 
 
 
• Hence, the most appropriate option to improve the sentence is **Option 3**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Option 1: Taught him the topic** (उसे विषय पढ़ाया): Refers to the act of imparting knowledge or skills to someone.

 
 
• **Example:** The teacher taught him the topic during the lecture.
 
 
 
• **Option 2: Told him the topic** (उसे विषय बताया): Refers to informing or stating the topic without necessarily explaining it.
 
 
• **Example:** She told him the topic for the presentation but didn’t give details.
 
 
 
• **Option 4: Explained to him the topic** (उसने उसे विषय समझाया): Though similar, this phrase is less commonly used compared to "explained the topic to him," and is slightly less fluent in English.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher explained to him the topic for better understanding.
 
 

53:Tfb1,
The correct answer is **Option 2**.<
